notes.title: A word from the creator of Blon!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! My name is Maxime, creator of the Lazy Kiwi studio; its one and only member by the way.

I'm writing to you today to talk about Blon, my very first game. I remember very clearly that night five years ago, and the impromptu wake-up call at 5am: I had an idea, I had to write it down. Three hours and fifteen pages later, I was back to sleep.

I had a great desire to share this simple, unpretentious game, but I wanted the player to feel that he was progressing, while playing only a few minutes from time to time if he wished. I hadn't experienced enough games of the same kind, and that frustrated me.

On the other hand... how to do it without experience? So without any idea of where to start, and without the slightest hesitation, I threw myself headlong into developing and learning pixel art. And... it didn't look like much. By dint of learning and modifying, a first level was created, then two, then seven. Then I contacted a publisher, [b]PID Games,[/b] who was convinced by my game and accompanied me for the rest!

It will remain an incredible experience that I recommend to everyone. You never forget your first time, even if it's a blob!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/d4beb45760cb51cadbd5d859ef54a205cd830b96.png[/img]

notes.title: Join the Blob adventure!
notes.notes:
Welcome to Blon! Blon is a [b]cute 2D platformer[/b] in which you have to save your family and [b]defeat [/b]your mad brother by defeating dozens of [b]enemies [/b]and [b]bosses[/b].

[h3]Blon is participating in the Steam Next Fest which runs from June 16th to 22nd. Don't hesitate to playtest the demo of the game which is available during this period on Steam.[/h3]

You can already add the game to your [b]wishlist[/b] by clicking right here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1582990/Blon/


- Lazy Kiwi
